lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five primary horizontal rows. The centroids show higher density in the anterior region immediately posterior to the gill slits, with inter-cluster spacing increasing toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form a quasi-rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-saturated values above and a defined shadow-line below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of discrete, high-luminance circular blobs, with approximately 8-10 individual spots identifiable within the fin's boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a remora is visible swimming in close proximity to the shark's ventral-anterior flank.
